examples.quote: a sufficiently contrasting focus indicator (grey #949494 against white, with a contrast ratio of 3:1).
Pass: A customized checkbox with light grey check (#E5E5E5), which has a contrast ratio of 5.6:1 with the purple box (#6221EA).
examples.knownDiscrepancy: WCAG 2.2 formula gives 5.6994 (rounds to 5.7). The page's other examples round half-up correctly (e.g. 1.1854 published as 1.2), so 5.6 is an inconsistency in the page. Tested only for the claim it supports: at least 3:1 (SC 1.4.11).
